text.card: A red giant 5,530 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.01 solar masses and 13.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,842 K at its surface.
